in_sanskrit.name: मोक्ष
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The ultimate goal of human life is to attain moksha or liberation from the cycle of birth, death, and rebirth.

in_marathi.name: Mokshita
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Release from bondage or suffering
in_marathi.long_meaning: Mokshita हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit root 'muc', meaning 'to free'. Mokshita signifies the release from bondage or suffering, attainment of liberation or salvation.
